lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule for Djibouti in 2015. The classifications were spatially mapped to geographic units and stored in the FEWS NET Data Warehouse, then exported as GeoJSON and KML formats representing food insecurity scenarios for near-term projections.
